title: Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)
description:
Overview

Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional) – remote-first, worldwide applicants welcome. Compensation set based on agreed hours / work scope of part-time role (flexible). Engagement: Part-time freelance (5–20 h/week) with clear path to full-time within 12 months based on impact. Reports to: Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About tl;dv

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a "make it pretty" gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics. If you live and breathe design in tech / SaaS / AI, track the latest patterns, and want to grow from a part-time contributor into a core, full-time role, read on.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day-to-day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product-adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion-ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one-pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end-to-end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self-serve.

What Success Looks Like

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.
  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near-zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands-on design experience in SaaS / AI (agency or in-house). You know the category patterns - and how to break them.
  • Exceptional taste. Refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast-paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low-ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).
  • Bonus Points if You have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

What to Include

  • Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work).
  • For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal – your role – outcome (metrics if possible).
  • Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets).
  • Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

How to Apply

Email: ******

Important: Share your LinkedIn and portfolio. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters.

We move fast. The more your application stands out, the faster we’ll respond.

To learn more about our culture and how we work as a team, check out our Culture & Careers Page!

We really can’t wait to hear from you!

  • Seniority level: Mid-Senior level
  • Employment type: Part-time
  • Job function: Design, Art/Creative, and Information Technology

Descrição da Vaga

Analista de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Híbrido / Rio de Janeiro

Sobre a Stone

Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente. Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com atuação em todo o país. Valorizamos a autonomia, a proatividade, o trabalho em equipe e a busca constante por melhoria.

Atuamos na área de Desenvolvimento de Negócios, com atuação na gestão financeira relacionada aos custos com bandeiras. Principais objetivos: acompanhar custos, identificar cobranças, realizar o controle orçamentário, incluindo pagamento, provisão, reversão de notas e atualização do forecast. Participação em negociações com bandeiras e interação com outras áreas para otimizar custos e buscar oportunidades de eficiência.

Responsabilidades

  • Consolidar os dados de faturamento das bandeiras;
  • Realizar conferência entre os valores faturados e as notas fiscais recebidas;
  • Enviar notas fiscais para pagamento, dentro dos prazos e conformidades exigidos;
  • Efetuar provisões e reversões contábeis relacionadas aos custos das bandeiras;
  • Apoiar na atualização de controles internos e reports financeiros.

Pré-requisitos

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade, Finanças ou áreas correlatas
  • Excel intermediário (procv, tabelas dinâmicas, tratamento de dados)
  • Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes e organização
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalho em equipe

O Que Aumenta suas Chances

  • Conhecimento em processos financeiros (faturamento, contas a pagar, provisões, reconciliações, etc.)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas ERP (SAP, Oracle, etc.)

Jornada de Trabalho

  • 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Segunda a Sexta

Modelo / Local de Trabalho

  • Híbrido

Benefícios

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico; Hospital Virtual Verde; Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação (Sodexo); Gympass; Auxílio Creche; Seguro de Vida; Vale Transporte (para vagas presenciais); Convênio SESC; Salário Fixo + PLR (quando aplicável); Benefício Educação (Plataforma interna – Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

Inscrição, entrevistas com time de People, entrevista com a liderança, feedback sobre os resultados e próximos passos. Inscreva-se e venha fazer parte da Stone.

Observações de Diversidade

Nossas vagas são destinadas, entre outras, a pessoas com deficiência. Todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Somos a Doctoralia , empresa do grupo Docplanner , e estamos presentes em 13 países , sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês!

Nossa missão é “Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis”.

  • Capacidade de trabalhar com grande volume de ligações (e gostar de realizar ligações)

Informações adicionais

At Wisevu and our sister brands Homevu and CharityMarketing.com, we've been driving digital marketing success for over 17 years, specializing in SEO, digital PR, AI, content marketing, and web development for healthcare, home services, and charity clients in Canada, USA, and Europe.

Wisevu is a fully remote team of 20+ specialists. You'll work on exciting client accounts in major markets like NYC, Toronto, and Spain—implementing cutting-edge strategies that drive real impact.

Learn more at wisevu.com.

About The Role

We're looking for a talented Senior Media Buyer to join our remote team. This role is also commonly referred to as a Paid Ads Manager, Paid Media Manager, PPC Manager, or Digital Advertising Manager, depending on your background and industry experience.

What Will You Do?

  • Lead and oversee the strategic planning and execution of all paid media campaigns across Google, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
  • Manage and mentor a team of paid media specialists, ensuring campaigns meet client and business objectives.
  • Develop full-funnel ad strategies and budgets for multiple clients/accounts.
  • Present campaign strategies, reports, and performance results to stakeholders and clients.
  • Implement processes for performance tracking, campaign optimization, and reporting.
  • Stay ahead of platform trends and guide the team in testing and adopting new paid media tactics.

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media, with at least 2 years in a managerial role.
  • Professional English fluency.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Proven track record of leading successful Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns.
  • Experience managing and mentoring a team in an agency environment.
  • Deep understanding of performance metrics, conversion tracking, attribution, and reporting.
  • Strategic thinker with strong attention to detail and a results-driven mindset.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or other platforms.
  • Google Ads and Meta Ads certifications.
  • Google Analytics Certification.

Work-timings

Benefits

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote work.
  • The starting monthly salary between $2500-$3500 CAD, which will be negotiated during the interview based on competencies, skills, and experience.
  • Premium Employee Training.
  • Access to a highly experienced and knowledgeable team of digital marketing experts.

description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de UTI adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo HMPII, há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejar, organizar, monitorar e avaliar as atividades técnicas e administrativas assistenciais das unidades de enfermagem.
  • Desenvolver e aperfeiçoar sistemas, rotinas, procedimentos e métodos técnicos/administrativos, tendo em vista uniformizar, simplificar e aumentar a eficácia das atividades dos setores envolvidos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Pós-Graduação Completa em Terapia Intensiva, Paciente Crítico, Urgência e Emergência, Gestão Hospitalar, Gestão em Saúde, Gestão de Pessoas, Administração Hospitalar e áreas afins.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses de atuação em Unidade Hospitalar e Gestão de Equipe.

Informações adicionais

  • Local: Santa Cruz - RJ
  • Escala: Segunda a Sexta-feira - 40h semanais
  • Horário: 08:00 às 17:00
  • Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)

About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).

Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.

The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.

What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.

MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.

Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems (ATS/Compliance/Job Boards/HubSpot /Salesforce ).
  • Experience integrating QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools for automated invoicing/payroll with audit trails.

Nice-to-Have

  • Healthcare staffing/credentialing domain.
  • iPaaS/workflow tools (Zapier/Make), queues, human-in-the-loop review UIs.
  • Deploying AI apps on managed cloud (AKS/App Service or equivalents).
  • Information retrieval, knowledge graphs, or NLP research background.
  • Prior work on compliance-heavy systems (healthcare, finance, government).
  • Contributions to open-source AI/LLM frameworks or a strong portfolio of shipped AI projects.

Why AMX

  • Founding scope & ownership: Build the AI function—architecture, standards, roadmap.
  • Executive air cover: Direct line to the Head of Engineering; CEO-level sponsorship to ship.
  • Modern, open stack: Integrations across ATS, compliance, job boards, CRM/Marketing (HubSpot/Salesforce) , VoIP/SMS, CMS, accounting/payroll , and reporting—pick the best tool for the job.
  • Mission-critical outcomes: Help clinicians reach the bedside faster with fewer errors—visible impact on placements, revenue, compliance, cash conversion, and payroll accuracy.
  • Remote-first, pragmatic culture: Production over prototypes, HIPAA/PII first, human-in-the-loop where it matters.

EEO

AMX Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos:

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

Local de trabalho:

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system, with various moving parts and often contradicting signals. That creates an extremely exciting pool of opportunities to find gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analysis and models we need have different degrees of complexity, from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. We expect you to have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R
  • Reporting: If a complex system creates an exciting pool of opportunities, it also creates a high number of metrics that we need to keep track of to run the business efficiently.   • Analytics Engineering: Although it won't be your main focus, occasionally, you will need to work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets to empower our reports and end users within the organization.   • Bias for action: You understand that despite your careful approach to understanding problems and identifying opportunities, you actively try to avoid being a perfectionist or getting yourself tied up in knots. title: Engineer - Pipe System Design
description:
Join to apply for the Engineer - Pipe System Design role at NOV

Overview

Join Our Team and Shape the Future of Offshore Engineering! NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS) designs and manufactures flexible pipes and products for the offshore oil and gas industry. With operations in Denmark (Brondby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we deliver subsea equipment to global contractors and oil companies. We are looking for an Engineer – Pipe System Design Engineering to join our global team and support growth in Brazil.

Your New Role

You will be part of our global and international Engineering department, based in either Rio de Janeiro or São João da Barra, Açu Port, Brazil, working on several major flexible pipe projects in a multi-disciplinary environment. You will participate in a range of tasks leveraging your engineering skills to succeed.

Subsea Flexible Riser Analysis Engineer

You will design flexible pipe systems by modeling the dynamic offshore environment, simulating structure behavior, calculating loads, and evaluating pipe and subsea structure integrity. You will model components with Orcaflex and design the overall subsea configuration, calculating loads to assess feasibility of components such as pipe cross-section, end-fittings, and subsea structures. You will configure flexible risers (e.g., free-hanging, lazy wave) and define required pipe lengths and ancillary components like bend stiffeners and buoyancy modules.

  • Conduct comprehensive global analysis of flexible pipes and offshore structures under various extreme operating conditions.
  • Perform hydrodynamic and structural simulations to assess environmental forces (waves, currents, tides).
  • Analyze mechanical behavior of flexible pipes (bending, axial tension, compression, torsion).
  • Evaluate extreme environmental conditions (100-year events, fatigue life, installation scenarios) for safe deployment and 20+ year operations.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders to ensure project execution.
  • Prepare detailed technical reports and documentation to communicate analysis results and recommendations.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards (API Spec 17J and RP17B), regulations, and safety requirements.

About You

From the moment you start your career in NOV, we support your development. We seek engineers who can contribute their expertise to our team. Key skills and competencies include:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience in structural analysis and dynamic simulation, preferably offshore.
  • Proficiency in finite element analysis software Orcaflex or similar.
  • Strong understanding of fluid mechanics, hydrodynamic loading, wave theory, fatigue analysis, and nonlinear material behavior.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and teamwork ability.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present complex technical information clearly.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English at a professional level.

Subsea Flexible Pipe Design Engineer

You will design the core product, the flexible pipe cross-section, ensuring manufacturability, material compatibility, and structural integrity, while analyzing failure modes and performing complex calculations. You will interface with other engineering disciplines to deliver technically feasible and cost-effective pipe solutions.

  • Conduct local cross-sectional analysis of flexible pipes under various conditions using in-house tools.
  • Perform structural analysis to assess failure modes, feasibility, and cost effectiveness.
  • Analyze mechanical behavior (bending, axial tension, compression, torsion).
  • Evaluate extreme environmental conditions (100-year events, fatigue life, installation) for safe deployment and 20+ year operation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and external stakeholders to ensure project success.
  • Prepare technical reports and deliver analysis results and recommendations.
  • Provide technical support to factories concerning manufacturing deviations and non-conformities.
  • Ensure compliance with API Spec 17J, RP 17B, regulations, and safety requirements.

From The Moment You Start Your Career

We support your personal and professional development. We welcome both newly graduated and experienced engineers. Skills and competencies for success include:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Materials, or related field.
  • Experience in structural analysis and project engineering.
  • Proficiency in finite element analysis and programming (Python and/or VBA).
  • Strong understanding of solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, fatigue analysis, thermodynamics, and nonlinear material behavior.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and teamwork.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present complex technical information clearly.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English at a professional level.

Why Join Us?

Flexible pipes are highly engineered, customized products for offshore environments. This role offers lifelong learning through challenging, unique projects that support the world’s energy supply. NOV SPS is at the forefront of offshore engineering, delivering cutting-edge solutions with a focus on safety and reliability. We offer a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a supportive work environment that values innovation and continuous learning. Business travel is limited; you may visit customers globally and our factory in Açu Port to see designs come to life.

Are you Interested?

If you’re interested, please apply. We’re happy to provide additional information or clarification during the selection process. Apply now to join a company dedicated to innovation, excellence, and safety.

title: Client & Talent Support Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Client & Talent Support Associate role at Toptal

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe, Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a Client & Talent Support Associate, you will work with a forward-thinking, globally distributed, and fully remote team whose job is to provide exceptional customer service with a strong support-centered philosophy.

As a member of our Toptal Service Center, you will help promote and preserve Toptal’s dedication to providing an outstanding experience to our clients and talent alike. As an individual contributor, this candidate will have the opportunity to deliver the best impression and ensure that impression leads to revenue generation. You will be on the front lines of support.

The ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and talent inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Provide support to clients and talent using various communication tools such as email, chat, and phone.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Talent Operations, Finance, and Legal teams to proactively meet the needs of both clients and talent. Utilize Zoom and Slack for effective communication and teamwork.
  • Partner with client support teams and internal stakeholders to address and resolve issues promptly for clients and talent.
  • Demonstrate a sense of urgency in resolving concerns for both clients and talent, involving relevant parties as necessary.
  • Manage escalated cases and offer immediate assistance to clients and talent in the absence of management.
  • Serve as a knowledgeable resource by staying updated on all Toptal service offerings and policies.
  • Support new and existing team members through training and assisting with learning new tasks. Engage in special projects and initiatives to contribute to the success of both clients and talent.

What to Expect

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes for client support.
  • Complete customized onboarding to understand the Toptal business model.
  • Begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, vision, and the talent industry.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Familiarize yourself with support materials for clients and talent.
  • Learn about key internal and external stakeholders and how Toptal teams support clients and talent.
  • Understand the ticketing system and client request processes.
  • Independently resolve client and talent issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive understanding of the client and talent experience.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be fully integrated into the team.
  • Understand Toptal’s issue resolution process and take ownership of client and talent resolution.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to resolve support tasks.
  • Balance tasks efficiently for maximum productivity.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Act as a primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, clients, and talent, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Navigate systems and support materials confidently, training new team members.
  • Meet resolution SLAs consistently.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Contribute productively and consistently to the team.
  • Assist in onboarding, training, and supporting new team members.
  • Maintain a world-class client experience throughout the client and talent lifecycle.
  • Continue to promote an environment of teamwork and collaboration.

Qualifications and Job Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of customer service experience across various communication channels.
  • Experience in phone and email communication is required, with chat and Zendesk experience considered a plus.
  • Ability to work without much supervision and handle time and resources efficiently.
  • Knowledge of the software development field is a significant plus.
  • Must be a strong performer in high-volume, high-pressure situations.
  • Communication. Must be able to have difficult conversations and de-escalate situations when appropriate. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are required.
  • Collaborative. Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to build strong, customer-centric relationships, both internally and externally.
  • Team-oriented. Cooperative and promotes an environment of continuous improvement.
  • Problem solver. Must be capable of uncovering issues and resolving them quickly and effectively.
  • Time management. Must be able to work independently and manage time and resources efficiently; can successfully manage competing priorities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

Toptal is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from diverse candidates.

title: Operations Coordinator (Remote)
description:
This pivotal role is on the front line of our customer experience, ensuring a high-quality, consistent, and efficient journey for our customers. The Operations Coordinator works closely with the Professional Services and Customer Success teams, serving as a primary point of contact for customers and a central hub for internal coordination.

You will be responsible for managing initial customer inquiries, handling the operational tasks and scheduling logistics of all Professional Services projects, and driving improvements to the overall customer experience. This position requires frequent interaction with numerous departments, including Sales, Contracts, Finance, Support, and Managed Services, to ensure seamless service delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Customer Engagement & Communication: Serve as the first responder to all customer requests via phone and email, assessing their needs and connecting them to the correct internal resources.
  • Customer Engagement & Communication: Establish and manage initial communications with customers to align on the overall schedule for all Professional Services engagements.
  • Customer Engagement & Communication: Maintain frequent and consistent status reviews and follow-ups with internal and customer contacts to ensure active engagement.
  • Customer Engagement & Communication: Act as the first level of escalation for customer complaints, working to find a swift resolution.
  • Scheduling & Coordination: Take full ownership of scheduling requirements on assigned Professional Services engagements, setting up new projects, and assigning consultants.
  • Scheduling & Coordination: Join and support customer-consultant calls.
  • Scheduling & Coordination: Update and maintain the Professional Services Team Calendar to provide high-level visibility to team utilization and project lead times.
  • Scheduling & Coordination: Manage and schedule frontline team coverage to ensure consistent customer support.
  • Operational Excellence: Help our team deliver high-quality, efficient, and profitable services that result in high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Operational Excellence: Provide timely updates for management-level reporting, including Key Performance Indicators, project backlog, and time tracking.
  • Operational Excellence: Update customer accounts and portal information, and perform dashboard review and cleaning.
  • Operational Excellence: Serve as a primary resource for other teams (Sales, Customer Success, Managed Services) for scheduling requirements and cross-team collaboration.
  • Operational Excellence: Create and maintain documentation for new and existing processes.

Your Experience

  • Possesses strong interpersonal and communication skills in English (both spoken and written).
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in a Professional Services, Customer Service, or similar operational environment, handling project coordination and customer communications.
  • Maintains a positive, customer-first, and team-first attitude.
  • Outstanding time-management, organizational skills, and a strong attention to detail.
  • Proven ability to perform in a client-facing role in a professional manner, with experience leading project calls with customers and internal team members.
  • Ability to adapt and adjust quickly to changing priorities and processes in a remote, self-directed work environment.
  • A natural problem-solver who can think critically and act in the best interest of the customer and the company.
  • Collaborative team worker who sees the value in working together to achieve common goals.

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Experience and a strong understanding of Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Google Suite.
  • Experience providing customer service within the tech industry, particularly with open-source communities and database technologies (MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
  • Possess a certification related to operations and/or process management.

This is a full-time, remote work-from-home position. Our team provides coverage from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. EST, and this role requires covering an 8-hour shift from 12 p.m. to 8 p.m. EST. A consistent and strong internet connection is required.

Why Percona?

At Percona, we believe an open world is a better world. Our mission is to enable everyone to innovate freely, by providing the best open source database software, support, and services. We make databases and applications run better through a unique combination of expertise and open source software built with the community for you.

Percona is proud to be a remote-only and globally dispersed workforce – we have colleagues in more than 50 countries! We offer a collaborative, highly-engaged culture where your ideas are welcome and your voice is heard.

Our staff receives generous benefits including flexible work hours and various paid time off programs, all your equipment for your remote office, funds for career development (external training, certifications, conferences), ongoing connectivity allowances, and the opportunity to participate in our equity incentive plan.

Venha fazer parte do nosso time de estrelas!

Nós valorizamos a diversidade e sabemos que um time formado por pessoas com perfis diversos nos torna tão fortes e únicos quanto nossas marcas. Responsável por construção de marcas de cervejas Premium no canal de consumo imediato (On Premise) através de ações de visibilidade, promoção e treinamento com o intuito de gerar valor de marca através de experiências ótimas de consumo que visam encantar, recrutar e fidelizar clientes e consumidores nos principais bares, restaurantes, casas noturnas e hotéis da área de atuação.

Principais atribuições

  • Reportar os resultados referentes a informações de performance de vendas por marca e embalagem, informações de budget utilizado por cliente atendido da carteira de clientes treinamentos de brigada executados e ações e movimentações do mercado, com informações consistentes e dentro dos prazos ao superior imediato.

Superior completo

E para desenvolver ainda mais a nossa liderança temos o Be Leader* – um programa interno exclusivo que acontece anualmente para fomentar o aprendizado e a conexão do nosso time de Líderes.

NÓS SOMOS HEINEKEN! No Brasil, já crescemos muito e estamos em um novo momento ainda mais movidos pela paixão em sermos a melhor cervejaria para nosso time, parceiros, clientes, consumidores e toda a sociedade.

description:
Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina

Join to apply for the Country Finance Manager - Brazil & Argentina role at Accelleron

Accelleron is accelerating sustainability in the marine and energy industries as a global technology leader in turbocharging, fuel injection, and digital solutions for heavy-duty applications. Building on a heritage of over 100 years as a trusted industry partner, the company serves customers in more than 100 locations in over 50 countries. Accelleron’s 3,000 employees are continuously innovating to deliver best-in-class products, services, and solutions that are mission-critical for the energy transition. You will join a team of experts in an exciting international environment, committed to excellence and innovation. Together, we support our customers in driving the transition toward sustainable industries with cutting-edge technology, deep expertise, and smart solutions. At Accelleron, we foster diversity and inclusion, welcoming and celebrating individual differences as a source of strength.

Job Description

  • As the key financial leader for Area Brazil and Argentina, you will act as copilot of the Country Managing Director (CMD) and be responsible for all local finance and commercial management matters.
  • Partnering closely with the CMD, you will play a critical role in steering the direction and success of the organization by providing timely and accurate financial insights and demonstrating strong business acumen.
  • You will lead and oversee all aspects of controlling, accounting, reporting, internal control, commercial management, fiduciary responsibilities, treasury, and tax matters to sustainably optimize business performance and financial position.
  • Representing the company externally, you will ensure full compliance with all legal requirements and internal policies.
  • The Country Finance Manager (CFM) reports to the Global Division Controller & Commercial Manager Service and the Country Managing Director.

Your Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership: Contribute to the local implementation of the Accelleron business strategy, providing strategic financial leadership and direction.
  • Business Planning: Develop and translate strategy into comprehensive business plans (budget/forecast), set measurable targets, and coordinate/oversee the corresponding processes. Assess financial implications of strategic decisions, create, and evaluate business scenarios, and initiate corrective actions when necessary.
  • Performance Management and decision support: Monitor financial performance across multiple dimensions, delivering insights to support both operational and strategic decision-making. Drive cost structure optimization, productivity improvements, and capital efficiency to maximize value creation.
  • Commercial and Risk Management: Identify and communicate commercial and financial risks and opportunities arising from business propositions, such as contracts. Conduct risk and contract reviews in line with global policies and standards to minimize risks and exposure. Monitor overdue accounts to mitigate default risk and safeguard company assets.
  • Financial Reporting: Establish and oversee processes and tools to ensure transparent and reliable financial data, reported in compliance with Group standards (US-GAAP) and financial closing schedules.
  • Accounting and Statutory Reporting: Ensure accurate financial bookkeeping (via our external Accounting Service Provider) in accordance with local accounting principles. Ensure timely preparation of accurate statutory financial statements.
  • Tax Compliance: Responsible for the preparation and filing of accurate tax returns (including timely payment) for corporate income taxes, transfer pricing and indirect taxes, in collaboration with your tax service provider. Ensure adherence to Accelleron tax policies as well as local and international tax regulations to ensure full tax compliance. Monitor changes in local tax legislation and assess their impact with local and global experts.
  • Governance, Compliance, and Audits: Establish and maintain local governance in line with corporate standards, regulations, policies, and legal requirements. Ensure effective execution of internal controls for financial and specified non-financial operations. Coordinate external audits and support internal audits, acting as a liaison with the global legal and integrity function. Act as Secretary to the Board of Directors. Ensure regulatory filings, reporting, and other general affairs tasks.
  • Treasury Management: Secure, plan and manage the company’s liquidity, including investment and debt management. Responsible for the local bank relationships, including the management of bank accounts, bank guarantees and other local banking services. Identify and manage foreign exchange risks, implementing hedging strategies in accordance with Group policies. Oversee the company's local insurance policies and credit risk management in alignment with Group guidelines.

Your Background

  • University degree in Finance/Controlling or Chartered Financial Accountant (e.g., ACCA, ACA, ICAEW, ICAS, CPA, CIMA) or extensive practical work experience with demonstrated achievements.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of local statutory accounting principles (BR GAAP, ARG GAAP) and US-GAAP/IFRS, combined with practical application experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in tax compliance, specifically in preparing and filing corporate income tax returns, managing transfer pricing, and handling indirect taxes.
  • Strong financial background with a structured and results-oriented approach and exceptional analytical skills.
  • High IT proficiency with experience in SAP (S4Hana is a strong advantage) and Microsoft Office products.
  • Proven team player with strong problem-solving skills, an open-minded approach to challenges, and the persistence to deliver on time.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, ideally with corresponding work experience from within a matrix organization.
  • 7+ years of experience in a controlling/accounting role within an international environment, preferably with an industrial background.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with a commitment to coaching and developing team members to reach their professional goals.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is a must, while proficiency in Spanish is a strong advantage

Your Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • International development opportunities
  • Modern office environment with flexible working arrangements
  • Lunch allowances
  • Insurance policy
  • Employee Assistance program

title: Client Experience Operations Specialist
description:
Toptal launches HireGlobal The most competitively priced global workforce payroll platform.

Client Experience Operations Specialist

About Toptal

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary

As a member of our Toptal Service Center team, you will work closely with the Director, Client Experience, and the leadership of the Toptal Service Center to ensure we have the data, tools, and workflows needed to operate at our best. You will be responsible for extracting and analyzing data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk, creating clear insights and reporting packages for leadership. You will also own and optimize our support systems (Zendesk, Slack, automations), helping to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across the organization.

Our ideal candidate has outstanding discipline, is highly passionate, and is eager to learn, grow, and develop. You will thrive in a fast-paced environment and strive to go above and beyond to effectively resolve clients’ and client services’ inquiries, issues, and concerns while maintaining a high level of client satisfaction.

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

  • Leverage SQL, Zendesk, and Tableau to analyze data and deliver actionable insights and reporting packages for the Customer Support leadership team.
  • Own and optimize Zendesk configuration (queues, triggers, macros, automations) and support tools such as Slack workflows and Zapier integrations to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
  • Work collaboratively with the team’s managers and cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, and Operations) to ensure systems and workflows align with business needs.
  • Act with a sense of ownership in identifying process gaps, recommending improvements, and implementing scalable solutions.
  • Maintain process documentation and act as a subject matter expert for tools, data extraction, and reporting practices.
  • Support ad-hoc analysis and operational projects, providing leadership with the insights needed for decision-making.
  • Assist with training and onboarding for team members on tools, workflows, and data processes.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Onboard and integrate into Toptal.
  • Become familiar with the various platforms and systems Toptal utilizes to offer timely and exceptional client support.
  • Complete customized onboarding to successfully navigate through the organization and understand the moving parts that make up the Toptal business model.
  • Rapidly begin learning about Toptal’s history, culture, and vision, with a focus on the state of the talent industry, the Future of Work, and the core messages important to Toptal.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Familiarize yourself with the extensive support materials available to successfully support our clients and talent.
  • Learn the key internal and external stakeholders and how clients can best be served by the different Toptal teams during their lifecycle.
  • Have a solid understanding of the Toptal platform as it relates to clients and the most frequent request processes.
  • Effectively and independently resolve client issues.
  • Gain a comprehensive working knowledge of the client experience from start to finish.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Confidently onboard to our support organization, tools, and workflows.
  • Built strong working relationships with the Director and Support Managers.
  • Be comfortable extracting data from Tableau, SQL, and Zendesk to produce accurate weekly and ad-hoc reports.
  • Learn and document our existing Zendesk setup, Slack workflows, and automations.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Be recognized as the “go-to” person for data extraction, workflow troubleshooting, and Zendesk admin needs.
  • Independently produce reporting packages and insights that help leadership make decisions.
  • Deliver at least 2–3 workflow or automation improvements that save the team measurable time.
  • Actively document processes and creating clarity around how tools and data are used.
  • Start to contribute ideas for larger process or system enhancements.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Be fully confident operating as the operational backbone of the support organisation while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
  • Anticipate leadership needs by proactively surfacing insights, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Lead small-to-medium operational projects (queue redesign, automation rollouts, feature pilots).
  • Establish clear reporting and automation processes that run smoothly without micromanagement.
  • Be trusted as both a subject matter expert in tools and a partner in shaping how support operates at scale.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required.
  • 3+ years of experience in operations roles.
  • Intermediate SQL proficiency is required.
  • Strong proficiency with G Suite tools, especially tools for analysis and reporting.
  • Zendesk admin experience, including managing queues, triggers, macros, and dashboard setup, is a strong advantage.

  • Enhancing our designs to build thought-leadership as a bold brand within AI SaaS.

Who You Are

  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI; you've got references at your fingertips.
  • Not afraid to be bold. You can defend strong creative while staying coachable.

  • Tools: Figma & WordPress / Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus if you can add light motion (After Effects, or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • Have 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Can produce quick micro-motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understand performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb-stop, offer framing, mobile-first).
  • Have experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

The Opportunity

  • Start part-time freelance; earn your way into a full-time seat in = 12 months through results.
  • Ship work that's seen by millions, not buried in decks.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.

  • Ubuntu Linux kernel plan, execution, benchmarking and stress testing
  • Optimized kernels for key silicon and cloud partners
  • Confidential computing and next-generation security primitives
  • Developer platforms such as Raspberry Pi and RISC-V
  • Enabling Ubuntu on a wide range of embedded systems
  • Kernel Livepatch, which delivers critical kernel fixes without rebooting
  • FIPS compliance
  • Real-Time and Low Latency kernel variants and patch-sets
  • Virtualization or abstraction engines
  • Container technology
  • Security with AppArmor, SECCOMP, namespaces and more
  • Networking - in particular performance and security
  • Storage - we are particularly interested in Ceph and DRBD

We hire candidates of all experience levels from recent university graduates through seasoned industry experts. You must have outstanding academic results, a background in software engineering, be motivated to work in a distributed team and willing to travel globally twice a year for company engineering events.

Location: Working from home, worldwide. We have kernel teams and openings in every time zone and – with the notable exception of Taipei, Taiwan – have no offices and therefore no pressure to work from an office.

What the role entails

  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Work closely with external silicon, cloud, or hardware manufacturer delivery teams on bleeding-edge platforms
  • Diagnose and resolve issues in the kernel reported by customers, the community, and discovered by your own rigorous testing
  • Take personal responsibility for the delivery of a flavour of the Ubuntu Linux kernel
  • Improve tooling and automation for delivery and test of Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Submit, review, and apply kernel patches, working with both internal and external upstream maintainers

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded
  • Experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential
  • Solid background with git
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills

  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSP's, and other low level system engineering
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded
  • Understanding of Linux kernel upstream processes and release cycle
  • Performance engineering and security experience
  • Solid background in CI/CD and process automation
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Our teams exhibit work-play energy that supports individual growth, as well as encourages the freedom of creativity and “thinking outside the box.”

Our Core Values:

  • Pursuit of Excellence: We are extremely competitive, ambitious, and driven to be exceptional – as individuals, teams, and as an organization. There is no standard high enough and we will never settle. We aspire to attract, retain, and empower the very best people.
  • Startup Mentality: Outliant began with 5 startup founders, and startup culture is deep in our DNA. It’s a critical advantage that allows us to move faster, be more resourceful, and empower our team at all levels. We are in the early chapters of our journey.
  • World-Class Remote Collaboration: Outliant is (and always has been) a 100% remote company – we have no offices and our teams are distributed around the world. Given the freedom and autonomy this provides, we require that our people excel in this remote structure.

About the role: We’re seeking a full-time Web Designer (Marketing-Focused) to join our team and help craft seamless and engaging user experiences across our projects.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for designing fully responsive visuals from concept to completion, ensuring exceptional user experiences. Your primary focus will include creating marketing landing pages, managing related advertisements, and executing branding initiatives.

We’re looking for a creative professional with strong skills in developing impactful marketing materials while maintaining brand consistency across multiple channels.

For candidates outside the EST time zone, this position requires some overlap with EST working hours.

Seniority Level : Senior Level

Responsibilities:

  • Visual Design:
    • Creating Visual Content: Designing marketing materials such as landing pages, social media graphics, email templates, and advertisements that align with the brand’s visual identity and marketing goals.
    • Brand Consistency: Ensuring all designs maintain consistency with the brand’s guidelines and messaging across different platforms and channels.
    • Campaign Design: Developing visuals for marketing campaigns, including banners, promotional materials, and other assets to support marketing strategies and goals.
  • Market Research and Analysis:
    • Conduct thorough user research to understand user needs, behaviors, and preferences.
    • Analyze industry trends and competitor designs to create innovative and effective marketing materials.
  • Information Architecture:
    • Develop information architecture and user flows to create intuitive and effective user experiences.
    • Organize and structure content for optimal user engagement and navigation.
  • Usability Testing:
    • Plan and conduct usability testing sessions to gather feedback on designs and identify areas for improvement.
    • Iterate designs based on user testing results and feedback.
  • Accessibility and Inclusivity:
    • Ensure designs are accessible to users with diverse abilities and needs.
    • Stay updated on accessibility standards and integrate them into the design process.
  • User Interface Design:
    • Design visually appealing and user-friendly interfaces that align with brand guidelines.
    • Create low-fidelity and high-fidelity wireframes to visualize and communicate design concepts.
    • Develop interactive prototypes to test and iterate on design solutions.
  • Organization & Documentation:
    • Produce detailed visual and interaction assets to streamline the development team's implementation of designs.
    • Handoff Delivery: Prepare and deliver comprehensive design handoffs to engineering teams, including detailed specifications and design systems.
    • Industry Awareness: Stay up-to-date with industry design trends and technologies to create innovative and effective products.
  • Collaboration:
    • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
    • Drive collaborative client interactions to elevate designs beyond expectations.
    • Receiving and incorporating feedback from stakeholders to refine and improve designs.
  • Ownership:
    • Managing multiple design projects simultaneously, adhering to deadlines, and ensuring high-quality deliverables.
    • Strategic thinking to align design efforts with overall business goals.
    • Decision-making skills to resolve design conflicts and make informed choices.

Requirements:

  • Minimum of 5 years of professional design experience, preferably in a B2B environment, including agency, tech, or freelance work.
  • Graphic Design Skills: Expertise in creating compelling visual content with strong understanding of design principles, typography, and color theory.
  • UI Skills: Excel in creating scalable UI designs for desktop and mobile using Figma and Adobe Suite.
  • Web Mastery: Showcase advanced proficiency in web design, with a deep understanding of user interfaces, user experience principles, and the ability to create visually compelling and user-friendly websites.
  • Organization: Skilled in systemic design for team-wide use, covering components, typography, colors, grids, and margins.
  • Accountable: Take ownership, solve problems independently, and commit to project success.

description:
Data Analyst: A/B-tests and customer onboarding (Remote)

Constructor is the next-generation platform for search and discovery in ecommerce, built to explicitly optimize for metrics like revenue, conversion rate, and profit. Our search engine is entirely invented in-house utilizing transformers and generative LLMs, and we use its core and personalization capabilities to power everything from search itself to recommendations to shopping agents.

Engineering is by far our largest department, and we've built our proprietary engine to be the best on the market, having never lost an A/B test to a competitive technology. We're passionate about maintaining this and work on the bleeding edge of AI to do so. Out of necessity, our engine is built for extreme scale and powers over 1 billion queries every day across 150 languages and roughly 100 countries.

We're a passionate team who love solving problems and want to make our customers' and coworkers' lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they do best can lead to great things.

About the Data Science Integrations team

Providing measurable KPI lifts is the goal of our platform, and most customers want to prove it running an A/B-test against either an in-house solution or one of our competitors. The Data Science Integrations team ensures that we run successful A/B tests at scale while minimizing manual engineering effort.

The team owns the customer onboarding process from a data quality standpoint, verifies the quality of customer integrations and tracking, and ensures that Constructor algorithms work as expected when ramping out tests to live customers. As a member of the Data Science Integrations team, you will use world-class analytical, engineering and data processing techniques to build the foundational infrastructure, tooling and analytical capabilities to enable the business to move forward.

Challenges you will tackle

  • Take initiative and perform data exploration to understand user behavior, suggest opportunities for improving our recommender & search systems, and implement pipelines for data delivery, as well as UX/UI changes
  • Ideate and deliver analytical insights to merchandizers to enable effective decision making and provide the best possible results during evaluation
  • Help the Customer Success team to communicate with merchandizers, fulfill their needs during integration, and provide best results for online metrics
  • Collaborate with the Customer Integrations team to make sure customers are integrated without bugs and with sufficient tracking to power data pipelines and models for search engine

Requirements

  • You are proficient in BI tools (data analysis, building dashboards for engineers and non-technical folks)
  • You are an excellent communicator with the ability to translate business asks into a technical language and vice versa
  • You are excited to leverage massive amounts of data to drive product innovation & deliver business value
  • You're familiar with math statistics (A/B-tests)
  • You are proficient at SQL (any variant), well-versed in exploratory data analysis with Python (pandas & numpy, data visualization libraries)
  • You are adept at fast prototyping and providing analytical support for initiatives in the e-commerce space by identifying & focusing on relevant features & metrics
  • You are willing to develop and maintain effective communication tools to report business performance and inform decision-making at a cross-functional level

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time
  • Fully remote team
  • Work from home stipend
  • Apple laptops provided for new employees
  • Training and development budget for every employee
  • Maternity & Paternity leave for qualified employees
  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact
  • Base salary range between $80k and $120k USD
  • Regular team offsites to connect and collaborate

Position Description

We are seeking an Oil Processing Engineer to join the Upstream Process Engineering Division part of our Process and Control Systems Department.

The Upstream Process Engineering Division is responsible for providing process engineering expertise, support and consultation in the areas of Gas Processing, Oil and Flow Assurance Applications.

As an Oil Processing Engineer your primary role is to provide specific technical expertise as well as to support and consult in specific areas of Crude Oil Processing.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for Crude Oil processing operating plants. Troubleshoot major plant upsets and/or chronic operational problems and to identify improvement opportunities, potential problems, and remedies to existing problems.
  • Provide technical lead in the evaluation of Crude Oil Processing and Water Treatment technologies to improve plant’s performance.
  • Develop plans and road maps for reviewing and incorporating new technologies including preliminary economics.
  • Conduct simulations studies process simulation software such as Aspen HYSYS and utilize process models for new and existing facilities to conduct production capacity assessment and identify plant’s bottlenecks.
  • Prepare preliminary scope of work (including process schematic and equipment list) to debottleneck existing facilities or design new facilities.
  • Coordinate the execution of capacity increase studies with operating facilities and detailed engineering design contractor and / or Vendors. This would involve setting the design basis and scope of work as require to ensure study is sufficiently comprehensive to satisfy objective.
  • Create/Update Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards related to Crude Oil Processing.
  • Support process design and engineering activities for new projects in conceptual, pre-FEED, FEED and Detailed Engineering phases.
  • Mentor and develop young Saudi Arab Engineers.
  • Develop new and/or deliver existing technical courses for engineers from operating facilities.
  • Present technical papers in major international conferences and issue papers in reputable oil and gas journals.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering. A Masters or higher education is desirable, but not required.
  • Minimum 20 years of experience working directly with Oil processing such as Gas / Liquid Gravity Separators, Liquid / Liquid Gravity Separators, Electrostatic Coalescers, Crude Stabilizers, Gas Compression Units, Primary and Secondary Water Treatment. With 3 years working with Crude Processing Facilities
  • Membership of a recognized professional institute is preferred.
  • Have adequate design experience in order to take a lead role as the company representative when working with engineering companies performing studies and design activities for Oil Processing projects.
  • Expert in process simulation modelling such as Aspen Hysys.
  • Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamic (CFD) Analysis is preferred.

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world’s biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Workforce Strategy & Planning

title: Accounting Manager/ Controller
description:
Hi there! We are South and our client is looking for an Accounting Manager/ Controller!

Note to Applicants:

  • Eligibility: This position is open to candidates residing in Latin America.
  • Application Language: Please submit your CV in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
  • Professional Presentation: We encourage you to showcase your professional experience by including a Loom video in the application form. While this is optional, candidates who provide a video presentation will be given priority.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounting Manager to join our growing offshore team. The ideal candidate will oversee the full accounting cycle for multiple high-growth startup clients, manage month-end close and reconciliations, ensure GAAP-compliant financial reporting, and lead day-to-day client accounting operations including AP, AR, payroll, and revenue recognition. They will also guide and review the work of client teams, maintain consistent accounting policies, and partner closely with startup executives to provide financial insights and recommendations.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary accounting lead and controller for 2–3 large, high-growth startup clients.
  • Manage and review monthly close processes, including balance sheet and P&L reconciliations (prepaid expenses, fixed assets, accrued liabilities, deferred revenue, etc.).
  • Oversee core accounting functions such as accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, inventory, and revenue recognition.
  • Ensure the accuracy and timeliness of financial reporting, delivering GAAP-compliant financial statements and management reports.
  • Partner directly with startup executive teams (CEOs, CFOs, VPs of Finance) to provide insights, recommendations, and proactive financial support.
  • Maintain consistent accounting policies and procedures across clients, documenting best practices to ensure scalability and efficiency.
  • Manage the day-to-day workflow of your dedicated client teams, reviewing their work and ensuring quality deliverables.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally within Furey to continuously improve client processes and enhance service delivery.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (CPA or equivalent designation preferred). MBA would be a plus
  • 15+ years of progressive accounting experience, ideally with exposure to high-growth startups, venture-backed companies, or outsourced accounting (at least 3 years of experience with an accounting firm is required)
  • 5+ years experience in a manager position
  • Fluency in English (written and verbal) required
  • Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and technical accounting concepts.
  • Proven experience leading month-end close and producing accurate financial statements.
  • Hands-on expertise with accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar) and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent organizational, prioritization, and project management skills with the ability to handle multiple clients simultaneously.
  • Strong client relationship skills and ability to communicate effectively with startup executives.
  • Experience in Inventory and Cost Accounting

Nice to Haves

  • Work experience at one of the big four US accounting firms (KPMG, PricewaterhouseCoopers, Deloitte, Ernst & Young)
  • Ability to create or improve processes. We’re a fast-paced startup and don’t always have lengthy process documentation available.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary in USD
  • Unlimited Paid Days Off + 14 paid federal holidays per calendar year
  • Time zone & Working hours: Monday to Thursday 9 am - 6 pm, and Friday 9 am - 1 pm EST.

If this opportunity sounds good to you, send us your resume in English!

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Python em quaisquer das bibliotecas de ML/DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).

  • Experiência em MLOps com quaisquer das ferramentas: AWS SageMaker Studio, MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.

Diferenciais

  • Curvas Precision-Recall (PR) e AP por classe.

  • Curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento.
  • Distribuição de IoU (Interseção Sobre a União).
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).

Dados Estruturados (como Diferencial)

  • Gráficos de resíduos em regressão.
  • Curvas de calibração de probabilidade.
  • Feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots.
  • Heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).

MLOps / Produção

  • Gráficos de detecção de drift de dados.
  • Distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput.
  • Consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop strong engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.
